_meta.purpose: Reusable facts for the Attested RWA template, gathered from official sources during the feasibility phase. Values marked TBD_RUN are measured on-chain during spike execution.
_meta.status_legend: SOURCED = from official docs/repo with URL; TBD_RUN = to be measured during spike execution; UNVERIFIED = not confirmable from an official source

json_rpc_relay.note: Hashio is dev/test only; no numeric rate limit published (UNVERIFIED).

mirror_node.CRITICAL_threshold_key_opaque: A ThresholdKey/KeyList returns _type=ProtobufEncoded with key=hex of the serialized protobuf Key message. The mirror node does NOT expand threshold or sub-keys into JSON. Must decode the protobuf (via SDK Key parsing) to verify threshold=2 over 3 attester keys.
mirror_node.schedule_executed_field: executed_timestamp (null until executed); signatories in signatures[]
mirror_node.action_failure_marker: result_data_type REVERT/ERROR (vs OUTPUT); HTS precompile appears as 0.0.359 / 0x167

hts.returns: leading int64 responseCode; SUCCESS == 22; does NOT revert on business failure by default

signatures.mintToken: mintToken(address token, int64 amount, bytes[] metadata) returns (int64 responseCode, int64 newTotalSupply, int64[] serialNumbers)

hrc719_associate_facade.note: call on the token's own EVM address; returns uint256 responseCode

form_B_eoa_facade.call_on: the schedule's own long-zero EVM address
form_B_eoa_facade.note: This is the MetaMask/ethers EOA path (S3). The EOA's own tx signature IS the schedule signature. Not callable from within a contract.

delegatecall_issue.summary: Calls into 0x16b from a DELEGATECALL frame (diamond/proxy) create schedules with a delegatable_contract_id admin key; scheduled execution fails INVALID_PAYER_SIGNATURE. Call 0x16b/0x167 from a DIRECT CALL frame only. Confirms the PRD 'no proxy/diamond' invariant.

hip_423_long_term_schedule.expiration_time: optional Timestamp on ScheduleCreate; defaults to 30 min after consensus if unset
hip_423_long_term_schedule.max_expiry: ~2 months (config scheduling.maxExpirationFutureSeconds); exact testnet numeric value UNVERIFIED - to confirm at run
hip_423_long_term_schedule.wait_for_expiry: optional bool, defaults false; when false, executes immediately once enough signatures arrive

saucerswap._evm_addresses_note: Docs publish only Hedera 0.0.x IDs; derive EVM 0x from mirror node evm_address field.
saucerswap.fee_tiers_note: 0.05% / 0.15% / 0.30% / 1.00% - FOUR tiers (extra 0.15% vs stock Uniswap V3)

pool_creation.method: NonfungiblePositionManager.mint(MintParams) payable - pool init folded into first mint; no standalone create call documented
pool_creation.fee: DYNAMIC: Factory.mintFee() returns tinycents; convert via mirror /network/exchangerate; pay as msg.value (setPayableAmount). No fixed testnet HBAR constant (UNVERIFIED by design).
pool_creation.mint_params: struct { address token0; address token1; uint24 fee; int24 tickLower; int24 tickUpper; uint256 amount0Desired; uint256 amount1Desired; uint256 amount0Min; uint256 amount1Min; address recipient; uint256 deadline; }

liquidity.hbar_handling: native HBAR NOT accepted directly; pass WHBAR token id + HBAR via setPayableAmount; recipient must associate the LP NFT id
liquidity.approvals: PositionManager needs AccountAllowanceApprove for input HTS tokens

swap.exact_input_params: struct { bytes path; address recipient; uint256 deadline; uint256 amountIn; uint256 amountOutMinimum; }
swap.hbar_in: set HBAR as msg.value via setPayableAmount; WHBAR as first path token

quoter.method: QuoterV2.quoteExactInput(path, amountIn) - read-only, on-chain (no REST needed)

rest_api.api_key: REQUIRED via x-api-key header; request by emailing support@saucerswap.finance
rest_api.quote_endpoint: NONE for V2 swaps - use on-chain QuoterV2

custom_fee_and_kyc.custom_fee_tokens: V2 does NOT support custom-fee tokens (FAQ). V1 supports fractional-fee-with-net-disabled only.
custom_fee_and_kyc.kyc_key_tokens: UNVERIFIED in docs - no statement. THIS IS THE S1 RISK: every pool/router/position-manager contract account would need KYC granted; no documented SaucerSwap mechanism for it.

template_json.local_path_support: NOT documented; giget git:./path unconfirmed (UNVERIFIED) -> gate-check likely needs a public/private GitHub branch
template_json.repo_root_file: template.json at repo root; CLI strips it from generated project after reading
